judged_text: The reschedule loop reuses the outer `credential` variable without resetting it per reference, so when a later reference's credential is missing from both calendarCredentials and the DB, the previous reference's credential is silently reused. Rescheduling a multi-host booking after one host deleted their calendar credential calls updateEvent with the wrong credential against the wrong reference uid/externalCalendarId (updating or 404-ing the previous host's calendar), and if the very first lookup fails, updateEvent(undefined) throws and the catch marks every reference as failed for the whole reschedule.
